cim: Artificial intelligence in social work: legal risks and responsible use
cim_eredeti: Artificial intelligence in social work: legal risks and responsible use
szoveg_eredeti:
Following the success of previous Community Care events in 2025 and 2026, join us online on 26 January 2027 for a thought-provoking half-day event that continues to explore the rapidly evolving role of artificial intelligence in social work practice. *Early bird rate until 15 December*

This conference is squarely focused on the practical implications of AI use:

The speakers are all leaders in their field across social work academia, law and regulation, and during the event there will be opportunities to ask questions of all the speakers.

Attendees will leave with a clear understanding of how AI can be applied to social work practice.
